summary: A Denver man fell 60-100 ft while hiking Blodgett Peak; reported overdue around 4 p.m. Saturday by family; a 12-hour search by El Paso County SAR and Colorado Springs Fire (~36 responders) found him alive but unconscious around 3 a.m. Sunday; he died of his injuries by the time crews got him back to the trailhead parking lot.
location: Blodgett Peak (off Woodmen Road), northwest Colorado Springs area
responding_agency: El Paso County Sheriff's Office / El Paso County Search and Rescue; Colorado Springs Fire Department
notes: Gazette (Colorado Springs) story reprinted via EMS World, article dated 2015-03-23; incident/fall Saturday 2015-03-21, found ~3 a.m. Sunday 2015-03-22; victim name not released; terrain described as extremely treacherous; autopsy pending at time of writing; embeds CSFD and EPCSAR tweets dated 2015-03-22. Fills thin year 2015 for El Paso on the EPSO line.
